{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No|Rewards = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in Act II of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. Canonically, it is the last act while in the actual event, it was followed by the no longer canon [[The Great Finale]]. After the first act, the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] begins the second act of his play. In it, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] takes part in a reenactment of both [[Halloween 2019 Event]] and [[Halloween 2020 Event]], where it is revealed that [[The Umbra]] was behind both of the events. While searching for more [[God Cube]] fragments, she found that they were hidden in [[Nightmare Carnival]] and [[Trick or Threat Town]]. For [[Nightmare Carnival]], she sent out [[Jack O' Bot]], here played by the [[Jack-o-Bot]] actor for both maps, though it was defeated by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. While not seen in the event itself, it was confirmed that [[The Umbra]] also sent out [[Lord Sinister]] to [[Trick or Threat Town]] but he was similarly defeated. ==Cutscene== [[File:Act 2 Cutscene|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays after finishing Wave 9 of [[The Haunted Past]]. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
[[The Umbra]] leads her forces to invade and conquer another location with a fragment of the [[God Cube]] in order to grow her own power.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the first cutscene.
'''Script'''
''The first frame of the cutscene is of a clock tower, with a darkened frame and an orange clock piece, reading 6:24. The setting is at night, apparently in a forested area, dark enough to obscure most details. The camera immediately does a half-turn upward to face a partially transformed [[The Umbra]], who appears to have undergone a visual transformation since her contact with the last cube fragment. She wears a gold-laced purple gown and pants that partially cover her entire body, with lighter-purple pauldrons, breastplate and shin plate. She wears an extremely long brown ponytail that is bound at the end by a gold ring. Her skin is a very dark purple, and her eyes are slanted and glow white.'' ''The Umbra staggers up to the side of a large boulder, bracing herself against the stone as if to rest. Then, she rotates, striking a counterpose and points at a distant object to command her forces forward. The frame zooms in as she does so, rotating to give a wide frontal view of her facial expression.'' ''The frame immediately zooms back out, settling on a rotated bottom-up view of [[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]], [[Scarecrow (Lunar Overture)|Scarecrow]] and [[Mummy (Lunar Overture)|Mummy]] pursuing an out-of-frame object. The three creatures appear to be in a [[Autumn Falling|partially lit clearing]] surrounded by rock faces and trees with a road guiding their rough direction.'' ''The frame follows their movement for a few seconds, rocking back and forth as it keeps them in center frame, then immediately rolls over to a image of a darkened path with a monochrome gray tint over the entire frame. The frame rotates upright, then zooms toward an object in the center which appears to be another fragment of the [[God Cube]]. The cube is not illuminated, but 0s and 1s begin to be emitted from the object's surface. The frame holds still as the cube emits said binary particles, then zooms into a closer view of the object before the frame fades to black.''
